I replied to Pree in a thread on their #central-random message. The reply confirms the Tansley Parcel signed order form deadline is 3 April, not the date in their #central-team post this morning.

As they asked, I took no other action and didn't change anything. I did tell them I don't keep notes between conversations, so the thread itself is the record. I also suggested they correct the date in #central-team if people there are working from the earlier one.

A signing deadline counts as an operational fact, not a finance figure. Pree also posted it in that channel themselves, so repeating it there was fine.
